imagery_row_provenance.accounting: 720 = 144 vision (1 beta/trial) + 288 imagery (1 beta/trial) + 288 attention (2 betas/trial)
imagery_row_provenance.empirically_corroborated: design matrix: vision/imagery runs 6 active cols x 8 onsets = 48; attention runs 12 cols x 8 = 96
imagery_row_provenance.within_block_ordering: beta row k == behavioral trial k (design onset order == behavioral trial order)

vision_cross_session_validation.finding: frozen decoder collapses on the imagery session (seen Set A 48/48 -> one candidate, seen Set B 45/48). Mapping is certified correct independently; the collapse is cross-session nonstationarity.

zero_shot_imagery_transfer.prediction_collapse: candidate 6 nearest for 96/96 Set B imagery trials
zero_shot_imagery_transfer.interpretation: exact-p significance is a single-candidate collapse artifact (one stimulus coincides with the collapse target); 2AFC below chance confirms no genuine transfer

state_transport_h4.held_out_target: all transport methods worse than identity (deltas -0.16 to -0.19); none beats matched random low-rank

sensitivity.note: the n=1 design (96 trials, 6 targets x 16 repeats, exact 6! null, collapse-guarded criterion) has 80% power to detect a genuine non-degenerate transfer raising MRR by ~0.14; none is present

falsification_uncertainty.uncertainty_h5: not meaningful under collapse; not claimed

gate_mapping: Imagery null: PERCEPTION=PASS, ZERO_SHOT=NULL_SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SENSITIVITY, STATE_TRANSPORT=NULL_OR_INCONCLUSIVE, RECONSTRUCTION_READINESS=BLOCKED, C3=COMPLETE_WITH_IMAGERY_TRANSFER_NULL
reconstruction_prohibition: No image reconstruction performed or attempted. C4 not begun.

supported: subj01: a strictly leakage-free perception-trained CLIP decoder recovers stimulus information from perception fMRI well above chance
subj01: that frozen perception decoder does NOT transfer zero-shot to the NSD-Imagery session — it collapses to a near-constant prediction (cross-session nonstationarity)
subj01: low-capacity output-space calibration does not rescue the imagery null on held-out targets
the single-subject design was well-powered to detect a genuine moderate transfer effect and found none
not_supported: thought reading, general imagery decoding, reconstruction of private mental imagery, reconstruction readiness

population_readiness.status: subj02/05/07 acquisition remains BLOCKED_BY_STORAGE (local 39GB free vs 40.77GB/subject); not abandoned
population_readiness.note: The cross-session collapse suggests future work should test whether other subjects show the same nonstationarity, and whether a session-alignment step (outside the strict zero-shot protocol) changes the imagery result. That is future work, not C4.

stop_condition: Work stops after the single-subject H2 decision and population-readiness plan. C4 (image reconstruction) is NOT begun.
